title: Oculas
tagline: This project combines Highlight.xyz's generative art repo with NounsDAO brand assets. Arbitrum contract address: https://arbiscan.io/address/0x3db09d29320a5ac19ba29192a49607f97406191a
description:
Arbitrum contract address: https://arbiscan.io/address/0x3db09d29320a5ac19ba29192a49607f97406191a

Generative Art with Highlight.xyz: Generative art refers to art that is created with the use of an autonomous system, often through algorithms and randomness. Highlight.xyz's generative art repository contains a variety of algorithms and tools for creating this type of art. The art we're generating creates concentric circles with randomized colors.

NounsDAO Font Family: NounsDAO is a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) that has its own font family. This was used to generate visual elements to the generative art.

Blockchain Inputs: Each piece of art is a unique representation of a specific blockchain transaction or set of transactions. The randomness inherent in these addresses could be used to determine the colors of the concentric circles, making each piece of art unique and tied to the specific blockchain data it represents.
